units.source_text: 在不太拥挤的三等车厢里，也有许多难以爱的活人，

en.t: Even in the not very crowded third class carriage, there were many living people hard to love,

units.source_text: 他们有的慌慌张张地抽着烟，有的剥着蜜桔皮。

en.t: some of them smoking in a fluster, others peeling mandarin oranges.

units.source_text: 邻座的一个像是一民间团体董事模样的老人在大声说话。

en.t: An old man in the neighboring seat, who looked like a director of some private association, was speaking loudly.

units.source_text: 他们一个个都穿着陈旧的不舍身的西装，

en.t: Every one of them wore an old, ill fitting Western suit,

units.source_text: 其中一人的袖口还露出条纹里子的破绽来。

en.t: and from the cuff of one of them even showed a torn place in the striped lining.

units.source_text: 我再次感到凡庸并不是随年龄的增长而有所衰颓。

en.t: Once again I felt that mediocrity does not decline with advancing age.

units.source_text: 这些农民装扮的人的黝黑而皱巴巴的脸，

en.t: The dark, wrinkled faces of these people dressed like farmers,

units.source_text: 连同因酗酒而嘶哑了的声音，表现出一种应该说是凡庸的精华。

en.t: together with voices grown hoarse from heavy drinking, revealed what should be called the very essence of mediocrity.
